newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade with most traders sidelined due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives, dealers said on Monday.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on lack of fresh factors. But some people are waiting for Tuesday's issue of the (U.S. October) housing starts figures, for more clues to market direction," a local dealer said.
"The numbers have been built into the market and most people have squared or are squaring their positions, so I don't think there will be much impact," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Monday/Tuesday, Tuesday/Wednesday and week-fixed were unchanged from last Friday's common 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at last Friday's 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8, six-months unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8 and nine-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent.
